entries.title: Mark 10:1
segments: On leaving that place, Jesus went into the district of Judea on the other side of the Jordan. Crowds gathered about him again; and again, as usual, he began teaching them.

entries.title: Mark 10:2
segments: Presently some Pharisees came up and, to test him, asked: "Has a husband the right to divorce his wife?"

entries.title: Mark 10:3
segments: "What direction did Moses give you?" replied Jesus.

entries.title: Mark 10:4
segments: "Moses," they said, "permitted a man to 'draw up in writing a notice of separation and divorce his wife.'"

entries.title: Mark 10:5
segments: "It was owing to the hardness of your hearts," said Jesus, "that Moses gave you this direction;

entries.title: Mark 10:6
segments: But, at the beginning of the Creation, God 'made them male and female.'

entries.title: Mark 10:7
segments: 'For this reason a man shall leave his father and mother,

entries.title: Mark 10:8
segments: And the man and his wife shall become one;' so that they are no longer two, but one.

entries.title: Mark 10:9
segments: What God himself, then, has yoked together man must not separate."

entries.title: Mark 10:10
segments: When they were indoors, the disciples asked him again about this,

entries.title: Mark 10:11
segments: And he said: "Any one who divorces his wife and marries another woman is guilty of adultery against his wife;

entries.title: Mark 10:12
segments: And, if the woman divorces her husband and marries another man, she is guilty of adultery."

entries.title: Mark 10:13
segments: Some of the people were bringing little children to Jesus, for him to touch them; but the disciples found fault with those who had brought them.

entries.title: Mark 10:14
segments: When, however, Jesus saw this, he was indignant. "Let the little children come to me," he said, "do not hinder them; for it is to the childlike that the Kingdom of God belongs.

entries.title: Mark 10:15
segments: I tell you, unless a man receives the Kingdom of God like a child, he will not enter it at all."

entries.title: Mark 10:16
segments: Then he folded the children in his arms, and, placing his hands on them, gave them his blessing.

entries.title: Mark 10:17
segments: And, as Jesus was resuming his journey, a man came running up to him, and threw himself on his knees before him. "Good Teacher," he asked, "what must I do to gain Immortal Life?"

entries.title: Mark 10:18
segments: "Why do you call me good?" answered Jesus. "No one is good but God.

entries.title: Mark 10:19
segments: You know the commandments--'Do not kill. Do not commit adultery. Do not steal. Do not say what is false about others. Do not cheat. Honor thy father and thy mother.'"

entries.title: Mark 10:20
segments: "Teacher," he replied, "I have observed all these from my childhood."

entries.title: Mark 10:21
segments: Jesus looked at the man, and his heart went out to him, and he said: "There is still one thing wanting in you; go and sell all that you have, and give to the poor, and you shall heave wealth in Heaven; then come and follow me."

entries.title: Mark 10:22
segments: But the man's face clouded at these words, and he went away distressed, for he had great possessions.

entries.title: Mark 10:23
segments: Then Jesus looked round, and said to his disciples: "How hard it will be for men of wealth to enter the Kingdom of God!"

entries.title: Mark 10:24
segments: The disciples were amazed at his words. But Jesus said again: "My children, how hard a thing it is to enter the Kingdom of God!

entries.title: Mark 10:25
segments: It is easier for a camel to get through a needle's eye, than for a rich man to enter the Kingdom of God."

entries.title: Mark 10:26
segments: "Then who can be saved?" they exclaimed in the greatest astonishment.

entries.title: Mark 10:27
segments: Jesus looked at them, and answered: "With men it is impossible, but not with God; for everything is possible with God."

entries.title: Mark 10:28
segments: "But we," began Peter, "we left everything and have followed you."

entries.title: Mark 10:29
segments: "I tell you," said Jesus, "there is no one who has left house, or brothers, or sisters, or mother, or father, or children, or land, on my account and on account of the Good News,

entries.title: Mark 10:30
segments: Who will not receive a hundred times as much, even now in the present--houses, and brothers, and sisters, and mothers, and children, and land--though not without persecutions, and, in the age that is coming, Immortal Life.

entries.title: Mark 10:31
segments: But many who are first now will then be last, and the last will be first."

entries.title: Mark 10:32
segments: One day, when they were on their way, going up to Jerusalem, Jesus was walking in front of the Apostles, who were filled with misgivings; while those who were following behind were alarmed. Gathering the Twelve round him once more, Jesus began to tell them what was about to happen to him.

entries.title: Mark 10:33
segments: "Listen!" he said. "We are going up to Jerusalem; and there the Son of Man will be betrayed to the Chief Priests and the Teachers of the Law, and they will condemn him to death, and they will give him up to the Gentiles,

entries.title: Mark 10:34
segments: Who will mock him, spit upon him, and scourge him, and put him to death; and after three days he will rise again."

entries.title: Mark 10:35
segments: James and John, the two sons of Zebediah, went to Jesus, and said: "Teacher, we want you to do for us whatever we ask."

entries.title: Mark 10:36
segments: "What do you want me to do for you?" he asked.

entries.title: Mark 10:37
segments: "Grant us this," they answered, "to sit, one on your right, and the other on your left, when you come in glory."

entries.title: Mark 10:38
segments: "You do not know what you are asking," Jesus said to them. "Can you drink the cup that I am to drink? or receive the baptism that I am to receive?"

entries.title: Mark 10:39
segments: "Yes," they answered, "we can." "You shall indeed drink the cup that I am to drink," Jesus said, "and receive the baptism that I am to receive,

entries.title: Mark 10:40
segments: But as to a seat at my right or at my left--that is not mine to give, but it is for those for whom it has been prepared."

entries.title: Mark 10:41
segments: On hearing of this, the ten others were at first very indignant about James and John.

entries.title: Mark 10:42
segments: But Jesus called the ten to him, and said: "Those who are regarded as ruling among the Gentiles lord it over them, as you know, and their great men oppress them.

entries.title: Mark 10:43
segments: But among you it is not so. No, whoever wants to become great among you must be your servant,

entries.title: Mark 10:44
segments: And whoever wants to take the first place among you must be the servant of all;

entries.title: Mark 10:45
segments: For even the Son of Man came, not be served, but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many."

entries.title: Mark 10:46
segments: They came to Jericho. When Jesus was going out of the town with his disciples and a large crowd, Bartimaeus, the son of Timaeus, a blind beggar, was sitting by the road-side.

entries.title: Mark 10:47
segments: Hearing that it was Jesus of Nazareth, he began to call out: "Jesus, Son of David, take pity on me."

entries.title: Mark 10:48
segments: Many of the people kept telling him to be quiet; but the man continued to call out all the louder: "Son of David, take pity on me."

entries.title: Mark 10:49
segments: Then Jesus stopped. "Call him," he said. So they called the blind man. "Courage!" they exclaimed. "Get up; he is calling you."

entries.title: Mark 10:50
segments: The man threw off his cloak, sprang up, and came to Jesus.

entries.title: Mark 10:51
segments: "What do you want me to do for you?" said Jesus, addressing him. "Rabboni," the blind man answered, "I want to recover my sight."

entries.title: Mark 10:52
segments: "You may go," Jesus said; "your faith has delivered you." Immediately he recovered his sight, and began to follow Jesus along the road.
